request: Automatically choose a platform-specific library path

candidates.prompt: One simple square software icon on pure white: bold dark-blue computer monitor on left, a thick black branching path on right with one branch highlighted green. Represents automatically choosing a platform-specific library path. Flat simple geometry, generous margin, no text, no border, no shadow.

source.evidence: The blue computer connects to three branches; only green identifies the chosen branch.

29x29.evidence: Monitor and branch endpoints remain separate.

30x23.evidence: The three routes remain visible, with a green branch.

30x18.evidence: The chosen branch differs only by color; there is no independent selection cue.
30x18.cause: The highlighted branch is encoded only by color.
30x18.correction: Use a large distinct selection mark on one branch.

16x16.evidence: Monitor and branching silhouette remain visible.

candidates.concept_summary: Platform chip points to library file
candidates.prompt: One simple square software icon on pure white: large dark-blue microchip at left, bold black right arrow, orange document with folded corner at right. Represents determining a platform-specific software library file. Flat thick geometry, generous margin, no text, no border, no shadow.

source.evidence: A blue chip points to an orange document, with clear outer margins.

29x29.evidence: Chip, arrow, and document are distinct.

30x23.evidence: The arrow and file remain separate.

30x18.evidence: Chip, arrow, and document are visible, though the chip has limited detail.

16x16.evidence: The chip becomes a blue blob, while the arrow and document remain discernible.

candidates.prompt: One simple square software icon on pure white: bold dark-blue folder with a large orange gear above it, representing automatic selection of a platform-specific library location. Flat thick shapes, generous margin, no text, no border, no shadow.

source.evidence: An orange gear above a blue folder suggests folder settings, not selection of an OS-specific library file.
source.cause: The action and library output are absent.
source.correction: Show a clear platform-dependent library file selection.

30x18.evidence: Gear and folder survive, but no selection or file cue is present.

16x16.evidence: Gear and folder silhouettes remain recognizable.

candidates.prompt: One simple square software icon on pure white: two thick dark-blue paths from the left merge into a single black arrow pointing right toward a large orange file document. Represents platform-dependent selection of a library path. Flat thick geometry, generous margin, no text, no border, no shadow.

source.evidence: Two blue paths merge into an arrow aimed at an orange file.

29x29.evidence: Two input paths, arrow, and file are distinct.

30x23.evidence: The converging paths and file remain visible.

30x18.evidence: Converging paths, arrow, and file remain separable.

16x16.evidence: Two paths and an orange file survive; the arrow is small.

candidates.prompt: One simple square software icon on pure white: a bold dark-blue computer monitor with a large orange magnifying glass overlapping its lower right, representing finding the library for the current system. Flat thick geometry, generous margin, no text, no border, no shadow.

source.evidence: A magnifier over a computer suggests inspecting a computer, not selecting a platform-specific library file.
source.cause: The action and library output are absent.
source.correction: Show a clear platform-dependent library file selection.

30x23.evidence: The monitor and magnifier remain separate.

30x18.evidence: The monitor and magnifier survive, but no library or selection cue appears.

16x16.evidence: Monitor and magnifier survive at the stress size.
